findings.claim: unreadableFrontmatter now scans the whole page and drops the requirement that it opens with a frontmatter delimiter. Any vault page without frontmatter that has a line such as `engram_id: 5` or `memorycard_id: 7` at column 0 is now counted as legacy and refused by name. A run over a vault containing such a page used to succeed and now ends with a refusal. The commit states this as intended, but an ordinary note or code snippet can block migration of a whole project. The only remedy is hand-editing that page. Body lines such as `project:` may also be read as the project assignment.

evidence: Diff inspected only; the old code returned false when the first line was not ---, and the new code scans every line of the page.
The no-project note is now printed once before the error return, so a failed run still shows it; the tests cover this.
